facts.Text: Follower beliefs provide some kind of yield or other inherent bonus. This applies to all cities and civilizations that follow that Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Founder beliefs provide a bonus that relies on the number of followers it has. Followers are citizens that follow that religion in all cities, regardless of whether or not that Religion is predominant in a city. This bonus is applied only to the civilization that founded that Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Worship beliefs grant a unique type of building that can be built in Holy Sites, or purchased there with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Every Worship building has different benefits.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Enhancer beliefs help spread the religion by making its natural religious pressure stronger or by making Missionaries and Apostles cheaper.

信徒信仰提供多种收益或其他内在加成。它适用于所有信奉该宗教的城市和文明。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]创始人信仰提供的加成由信徒数量决定。信徒是所有城市中信奉该宗教的公民，而不论该宗教是否是城市中的主流宗教。此加成仅适用于创建了该宗教的文明。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]祭祀信仰能授予一种特色建筑，该建筑可被建在圣地，或使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。每种祭祀建筑都有不同好处。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]强化信仰通过使其自然宗教压力更强大，或让传教士和使徒的价格更便宜，来帮助传播宗教信仰。

There are four types of Religious units: Missionaries, Apostles, Gurus, and Inquisitors. Religious units may be purchased through your city with [ICON_Faith] Faith and will adopt the majority Religion of the city in which they are built. Religious units' primary purpose is to spread their Religion to other cities. To do so, move the unit adjacent to a City Center—or inside it, if the city is yours—and use the Spread Religion action. This will convert some of the citizens of that city to Followers of your Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If more than half the citizens in the city are Followers of a particular Religion and that Religion has the majority of Followers in that city, that Religion will become predominant in that city. Cities with a dominant Religion will apply religious pressure on other cities within 10 tiles, slowly converting the citizens of those cities to that Religion.

宗教单位有四种：传教士、使徒、上师和审判官。可在城市中使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买宗教单位，其将采纳生产城市的主流宗教。宗教单位的主要作用是将其宗教传播到其他城市。为了达到这一目标，需要移动单位至市中心附近（如为本方城市，则移动到城市中），然后使用“传播宗教”行动。这样一来此城的部分公民便会皈依玩家的宗教。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]如果一座城市中有超过半数的公民成为某宗教的信徒，且此宗教在此城中拥有信徒数量最多，则此教将成为该城的主流宗教。拥有主流宗教的城市会对10个单元格以内的其他城市释放宗教压力，缓慢地转变这些城市公民的信仰。

Religion can also spread through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. Whenever a [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route is created between two cities, there is an exchange of Religion between those two cities. The origin city has greater outgoing religious pressure, but there is still pressure that comes back from the endpoint city. This information will appear in the menu with the [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route yield when choosing where to send a Trader.
也可通过 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线传播宗教。两座城市之间建立 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线后便会产生宗教交流。起源城市向外的宗教压力更大，但目的地城市也会反馈宗教压力。此信息将显示在商人派遣选择菜单的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线产量中。

A damaged Religious unit suffers a penalty to the strength of its Spread Religion action, meaning it will convert fewer Followers. If a Religious unit is reduced to 0 Hit Points from theological combat, it will die. When a Religious unit is defeated this way, all cities within 10 tiles have a religious pressure drop of the defeated unit's Religion equal to the strength of an Apostle at full health and then a boost in the victorious unit's Religion of the same amount. If a Religious unit is killed by a hostile military unit, then the Religious pressure will drop in cities within 6 tiles, and the Religious pressure drop is halved.
受伤宗教单位的传播宗教行动将受到减益，这意味着它所转换的追随者数量将变少。如果宗教单位的生命值在神学战斗中减少为0点，它会死去。用这种方式击败一个宗教单位后，在10个单元格内所有城市中被击败单位的宗教压力下降，下降量与一个生命值全满的使徒的攻击力相同，随后，获胜单位的宗教会获得同等量的提升。若宗教单位被敌方军事单位消灭后，6个单元格内城市中的宗教压力会下降，下降量减半。

facts.Text: The Diplomatic Victory is awarded to the Civilization that masters the World Congress, gaining reputation as a reliable friend, a defender of the greater good, and an outstanding negotiator.  Wield the [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor you have earned through your mutually-beneficial playstyle to accumulate Diplomatic Victory Points until you have reached the threshold to be named victor.
文明获得外交胜利的途径如下：掌控世界议会、被誉为可靠的友人、成为真善美的守护者，或成为出色的谈判方。用双赢的游戏方式获得 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，然后用其累积外交胜利点数。累积的点数达到阈值后即可获得外交胜利。

When World Congress meets, players who manage to pass their agendas will gain Diplomatic Victory Points.  Team up with other players to vote for a winning target/option combo, or spend your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to strong-arm Congress into seeing things your way, and you'll receive a Diplomatic Victory Point each time your selected option and target is the one to pass.
世界议会召开后，通过议程的玩家将获得外交胜利点数。与其他文明组队，针对目标/选择进行投票；也可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来掌控世界议会。选择的项目和目标通过决议后便能获得外交胜利点数。

As the World Congress progresses, eventually a Diplomatic Victory Resolution will appear in the mix of resolutions for voting. The resolution will propose awarding Diplomatic Victory Points to or removing Diplomatic Victory Points from a specific civilization. Use your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to vote yourself or an ally closer to victory, or use the other effect to slow down your enemies.
随着世界议会的发展，最后将出现外交胜利决议，文明可对此进行投票。决议将提出将外交胜利点数奖励给某个文明，或提出扣除某个文明的外交胜利点数。可使用 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持来为自己投票，或阻挠接近胜利的对手；也可通过其他手段来延缓对手的前进脚步。

Players can also earn Diplomatic Victory Points through participation in Scored Competitions.  Generate the highest score in Scored Competitions to receive Diplomatic Victory Points as part of your reward.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Additionally, players can earn Diplomatic Victory points by completing the Seasteads Tech, the Global Warming Mitigation Civic, or the Statue of Liberty, Mahabodhi Temple, and Potala Palace Wonders.
玩家参与积分竞赛便能获得外交胜利点数。在积分竞赛中得到最高分后所获奖励的一部分中也包含有外交胜利点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]除此之外，玩家研究“海洋家园”科技、解锁“全球变暖减缓学”市政、建成“自由女神像”、“摩诃菩提寺”或“布达拉宫”奇观后也能获得外交胜利点数。

A team wins a Diplomatic Victory when one of the players has enough Diplomatic Victory Points to win the game. A team does not combine their Diplomatic Victory points. When playing as a team, it may benefit you to choose one team member to pursue the victory, and for the remaining members of the team to vote for that player in all Diplomatic Victory Resolutions.
团队中的一个玩家获得足够的外交胜利点数后，团队便能集体赢得外交胜利。团队成员的外交胜利点数不会组合计算。进行团队游戏时较为可取的方案是让一个队友全力争取胜利，而其他队友则在所有外交胜利决议中投票对其进行支持。

facts.Text: To win a Domination victory, you must capture all original civilization [ICON_Capital] Capitals.
达成统治胜利的方法是占领所有文明的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都。

If you've lost your original [ICON_Capital] Capital, but still possess other cities, you can still win another type of victory: Culture, Science, Score, or Religious. However, you cannot win a Domination Victory until and unless you recapture your own original [ICON_Capital] Capital.
如您已失去原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都，但仍保有其他城市，您仍旧可以通过文化、科技、分数，或宗教方式获得其他胜利。但只有当您夺回自己的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都后，才有机会赢得统治胜利。

要达成团队统治胜利，所有团队成员必须守住自身的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都，并占领其他所有玩家的原始首都。

facts.Text: In order to obtain a Religious Victory, you must make your Religion the predominant Religion for every other major civilization in the game. This means not every one of a civilization's cities must follow your Religion, just the majority.
为了取得宗教胜利，您必须让您的宗教成为游戏中所有其他文明的主流宗教。这意味着并不需要文明城市里的所有人都信奉您的宗教，仅需多数人即可。

To win a Team Religious Victory, Religions founded by the team must be the predominant Religion in every other civilization.  The dominate Religions can be of any combination as long as the Religions were all founded by team members.
达成团队宗教胜利的方法是使团队创建的宗教成为其他每个文明的主流宗教。主流宗教可以是任意多个宗教的组合，只要它们均为团队成员建立即可。

Once you accumulate enough [ICON_Faith] Faith, you’ll be prompted to found a Pantheon, a precursor to the full-blown Religions to be founded later. Choosing which Pantheon to found depends on your short- and long-term goals for your civilization. After earning a Pantheon, you are well on your way to establishing your Religion. Unlike a full Religion, a Pantheon you choose will be unique to your civilization, and cannot spread outside your borders, or be displaced.
一旦您累积了足够的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，您会收到创建万神殿的提示，万神殿是您接下来会创建的某种成熟宗教的前身。万神殿类型取决于您为文明设定的长期和短期目标。获得一个万神殿后，您将很快创建自己的宗教。与完整的宗教不同，您所选择的万神殿是您的文明独有的，并且无法向国境之外传播，也无法被替换。

Description.en_US: To achieve a [COLOR:DiplomaticLabelCS]DIPLOMATIC[ENDCOLOR] victory, be the first to accumulate the target number of Diplomatic Points. Whenever you vote for the target and option combination that passes for a World Congress Resolution, you will earn one Diplomatic Point.  You can earn additional points through the Diplomatic Victory Proposal in the World Congress, by generating the highest score in Aid Requests, or by completing the Seasteads Tech, the Global Warming Mitigation Civic, or the Statue of Liberty, Mahabodhi Temple, or Potala Palace Wonders.
